highlights: UGREEN EC701 63W 3A USB-A + USB-C Car Charger
UGREEN EC701 is a compact and powerful car charger, equipped with one USB-C and one USB-A port, offering 63W charging power.
Thanks to advanced technology, it supports multiple fast charging protocols including PD3.0, QC3.0, AFC and FCP,
ensuring extremely fast and efficient charging for compatible devices.
Its compact and ergonomic design makes it easy to use and suitable for any car, taking up minimal space.
in addition, it is equipped with protection systems against overvoltage, short-circuit,
overcharging and overheating, providing complete safety for your devices.
Fast charging technologies: PD3.0, QC3.0, AFC, FCP
Compact and easy to use design
Multiple protections: overvoltage, short circuit, overcharging, overheating
